description: Source code for the DeviceEffectManager class within Android's AudioFlinger service, managing audio device effects, patches, and effect creation/compatibility.

classes.name: AudioFlinger::DeviceEffectManager
classes.description: Manages device effects, patches, and effect creation within Android's audio framework.

classes.name: AudioFlinger::DeviceEffectManagerCallback
classes.description: Callback class for handling effect disconnection events.

methods.name: onCreateAudioPatch
methods.description: Handles creation of an audio patch and notifies device effects.

methods.name: onReleaseAudioPatch
methods.description: Handles release of an audio patch and notifies device effects.

methods.name: createEffect_l
methods.description: Creates and connects a new effect handle for a device effect.

methods.name: checkEffectCompatibility
methods.description: Checks if an effect descriptor is compatible with the current HAL version.

methods.name: createEffectHal
methods.description: Creates an effect HAL instance based on UUID and session info.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of device effects for debugging.

methods.name: removeEffect
methods.description: Removes a specified device effect from management.
